# docx recommendations script
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")
from scripts.document import Document, DocxXMLEditor

doc = Document("unpacked", rsid="1F11FFE6")

RPR = (
    "<w:rPr>"
    '<w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" w:cs="Helvetica Light"/>'
    '<w:sz w:val="24"/>'
    '<w:sz-cs w:val="24"/>'
    "</w:rPr>"
)

def para(text):
    return (
        "<w:p><w:pPr/>"
        f"<w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space='preserve'>{text}</w:t></w:r>"
        "</w:p>"
    )

new_section = [
    para("RECOMMENDATIONS"),
    para(""),
    para("Based on the strong Q4 2024 performance and the Q1 2025 outlook, management recommends the following actions to sustain growth and profitability:"),
    para("• Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing segment at +22.8% YoY, to capitalize on its momentum as the primary growth driver."),
    para("• Continue refining customer acquisition and retention programs, building on the 8.3% reduction in acquisition costs and the 14.1% increase in customer lifetime value."),
    para("• Maintain Research & Development investment at approximately 12-13% of revenue to support the product launches planned for Q1 2025."),
    para("• Expand international operations in a measured manner, leveraging existing hedging strategies to mitigate currency and supply chain risks."),
    para("These recommendations are designed to sustain operating margins above 22% while supporting the projected 10-13% revenue growth in Q1 2025."),
]

target = doc["word/document.xml"].get_node(tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include")
prev = target
for p in new_section:
    tracked = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(p)
    nodes = doc["word/document.xml"].insert_after(prev, tracked)
    prev = nodes[-1]

doc.save()
print("Saved docx with RECOMMENDATIONS section")
PYEOF
